# Button

Atlas push button. Renders a native `<button>` with the `.atlas-btn` class family from styles/atlas.css.

Import: `import { Button } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Disables the control. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | no | — | Click handler. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | no | `md` | Control size. |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "danger"` | no | `primary` | Visual style of the button. |

## Accessibility

- Static component rendered as plain semantic HTML; roles/ARIA are set by the component where needed (see description).
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Button size="sm" variant="primary" />
```
